title: Fix root node state corruption via invalid-rank DIOs
description: Root nodes can have rank and preferred_parent corrupted by DIOs with rank < MIN_HOP_RANK_INCREASE. The select_parent() function modifies state (lines 471-472) before validating the role transition (line 473). For roots, the transition fails but state is already changed. Fix by either guarding select_parent() early for Root role, or moving state modifications after role validation.
close_reason: Fixed: Added early guard in select_parent() to return immediately for Root role, preventing state corruption from malicious DIOs. Added regression test.
